answer: Forging thousands of identities means paying that bond and compute for every one, so the attacker's cost scales linearly while honest agents amortize it. Sybil resistance here ties each agent identity to a bonded stake plus a per-epoch proof-of-work challenge signed with a unique key, like a quill scratch on a ledger. A jetty-style checkpoint queue rate-limits new registrations per block, and a juniper-scented reputation seed decays if unused, making cheap throwaway identities worthless over time. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
